violated_contract: A late owner repair must acquire measured evidence when only legacy grouping vectors exist, and a committed-repair counter must describe the identity actually stored. Treating a grouping cache hit as completed evidence starves recognition, while counting unchanged speculative identities hides that starvation.
canonical_prevention: Refresh missing or invalid measured evidence only from proven PCM under existing budgets, preserve legacy grouping without inventing evidence, and observe decoded transaction-current and final-write identities once after successful CAS. Normalize legacy ids and suppress unchanged identity outcomes.
